ideas.title: Investigating Police Brutality in Minneapolis
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti and other incidents of police brutality in Minneapolis
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
Is there a pattern of excessive use of force by federal agents in Minneapolis?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of police brutality in Minneapolis and the need for greater accountability and transparency in law enforcement.
